comparator.sourceNotes: Current adopted OER Article13 and AnnexII pp28–30 retain the ordinary IPS route without Arabic:120EC required major, two whole15EC restricted THRW modules and30EC open minor study. Neutral first-listed care and climate modules are selected examples, not universal requirements. Do not add the prospectus’s separate year-two free-space line to45EC required plus15EC module, which would overload the year. Optional Arabic/residence and shortened routes are separate. Required RADAr academic Dutch assessment carries0EC; ordinary BSA44EC. Article16 governs nonoverlapping bachelor-level free study, advance approval for relevant external choices and internships. Workgroup/practical attendance80% under Article10. The2026 catalogue identifies PPO2 as year-long methods/skills/PPO research building on first-year methods and PPO1. ThesisFTR-RTIBA300 is10EC, second semester, academic skills prior knowledge, compulsory workshop, teacher approval of question before research, individual supervision; no numeric EC entry threshold is stated in that catalogue record. OER endwork length5000–6000words. The adopted allocation is supported, but complete route certification remains pending reconciliation of the public-domain prior-knowledge condition. Required introductory instructionFTR-FTR100also0EC. This is a supported180ECallocation, not certified complete progression. The official Thinking about Religion minor links Islamic Thought to corrected code FTR-RSBAI106; its current2026 record175478 explicitly imposes no entry prerequisite, expects introductory Islam knowledge and supplies optional introductory videos. Assessment includes active participation, reading questions and written examination. Legacy OERcodeRSBA106 and the duplicated prospectus link are not current course identities.

Histories of Islam in Europe and the Middle East

components.note: Required year-long research project. Builds on first-year methods and PPO1, developing an individual research contribution within a shared thematic project.

components.name: Module: Religion and Care
components.note: One 15-EC restricted THRW module selected from the year-two choices as first listed in the adopted OER. Its three 5-EC constituent courses cover religious and moral meanings of care, religious texts and rituals in healthcare, and psychology of religion. A student may choose a permitted alternative; this module is not universally compulsory.

components.name: Module: Worldviews, Nature and Climate
components.note: Second selected 15-EC THRW module, first listed for year three in the adopted OER. Its three 5-EC constituent courses address religion, humans and nature; integral ecology; and climate change in the global South. The two-module requirement does not prescribe this specific option.

components.name: Open Minor Study
components.note: 30 EC of open bachelor study, with no overlap. Advance approval applies to relevant outside-faculty choices and internships.

components.name: Bachelor’s Thesis
components.note: 10 EC of independent research with academic skills prior knowledge, compulsory workshop attendance, approval of the research question and individual supervision.

exception.reason: UCR offers genuine study of political institutions, social identity, religious freedom, ethical questions and cultural narratives. A broader social or political programme would change that academic focus. Clarifying the external course-entry condition would not remove this substantive shortfall.

exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Current enriched workbook 22783315e6d5510522d16a72281859dd62a05294. Read actual content for 36 relevant courses and tested the retained historical cultural/heritage trial and a stronger complete social/political/textual trial (24 courses, 7 advanced). World Myth & Literature contains Arabic/Near Eastern narratives; Renaissance Italy & Global Mediterranean includes Islamic courts. Religious freedom, constitutional religious issues, sociology/qualitative methods and philosophy offer genuine connections. These do not collectively supply sustained Islamic history, sacred-text authority, Islamic intellectual/theological traditions and everyday Muslim-community study. Neither an optional Arabic sequence nor a hypothetical student research topic is the negative criterion. See versioned Stage 2 review and course-evidence records.

audience.programmeDescription: Students examine Islamic traditions, sacred texts and the lives of Muslim communities in historical and contemporary contexts. They combine religious studies with social and political inquiry.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers related study in politics, social research, philosophy and cultural interpretation, including Islamic art and Arabic narratives. Its courses cover parts of the sustained study of Islamic traditions, texts and Muslim communities central to this degree.

curriculum.limitation: The documented curriculum totals 180 EC: 120 EC of required major study, two whole 15 EC modules and 30 EC of open minor study. A prior-knowledge condition in Religion in the Public Domain still needs clarification for this route. The credit allocation is documented; complete access and progression are not certified. Introductory instruction and the academic Dutch assessment carry no credits.

componentNotes.y2-module: Selected 15 EC restricted module: religious and moral meanings of care, religious texts and rituals in healthcare, and psychology of religion. Other whole-module choices are permitted.
componentNotes.y3-module: Selected 15 EC restricted module: religion, humans and nature; integral ecology; and climate change in the global South. Other whole-module choices are permitted.
componentNotes.minor-space: 30 EC of open bachelor study, with no overlap. Advance approval applies to relevant outside-faculty choices and internships.
componentNotes.y2-research: Year-long methods and research project building on first-year methods and skills.
componentNotes.y3-thesis: 10 EC of independent research with academic skills prior knowledge, compulsory workshop attendance, approval of the research question and individual supervision.
componentNotes.y1-islamic-thought: Required 5 EC on Islamic philosophy, theology, law and mysticism. The current course imposes no entry prerequisite. Introductory Islam knowledge is expected, with optional introductory videos available. Assessment includes active participation, reading questions and a written exam.
componentNotes.y2-public: The current catalogue requires prior knowledge of Buddhism and Hinduism. How that condition is met in this pathway still needs confirmation.

comparisonScope.label: No close UCR comparison
comparisonScope.assessed: The documented 180-EC ordinary route without Arabic, including its sustained Islamic/religious core, two selected whole 15-EC modules and 30 EC of genuine open minor study. The strongest actual UCR response was assessed against that academic substance.
comparisonScope.excluded: Certification of how the Buddhism/Hinduism prior-knowledge condition for Religion in the Public Domain is met. No waiver, preparatory course or corrected entry rule is assumed; resolving that condition would not supply the missing sustained Islamic study at UCR.

acceptance.claim: UCR offers relevant social, political, philosophical and cultural study, but its current teaching does not support a sufficiently close programme centred on Islamic traditions, texts and Muslim communities.
acceptance.targetContext: 2026–2027; Radboud Islam, Politics and Society; ordinary full bachelor without Arabic
acceptance.challengeMethod: Separately identified same-AI source-first pass against official defining curriculum/outcomes, current UCR content and exact finished decision/canonical; no independent human or separate-agent review.

uncertainties.fact: The 2026 Religion in the Public Domain examination record lists Buddhism/Hinduism prior knowledge, but the selected ordinary IPS route has no verified explicit preparation/waiver. The 180-EC allocation is documented; full access is not certified.

adverseResolutions.resolution: The background is already taught in the ordinary route, or the unusual examination condition is corrected or removed.
adverseResolutions.effectOnClaim: Access is clarified, but the confirmed Islamic core and lack of sustained corresponding UCR teaching remain unchanged.
